definition: The four core candidates below contain a first, primary-source company-capture baseline. These are reported operating observations and product disclosures, not stock recommendations or evidence that an agentic tailwind is already monetized.

companies.mechanism: More action-oriented traffic, security inspections, and edge-compute demand could increase billable consumption if Akamai retains the workload.

evidence.label: Agent-traffic classification
evidence.value: AI fetchers and agents separated from training/search crawlers

companies.agenticRead: CIS growth and commitments support an AI-infrastructure capture hypothesis; more granular agent-traffic controls improve product fit and measurement. Management does not separately report agent-driven revenue, adoption, pricing, or ARR.
companies.counterpoint: Delivery and other cloud-applications revenue declined 6% YoY and non-GAAP operating margin was 25%, down five points. The 10-Q expects AI / cloud capacity investment to raise future capital and operating costs.

companies.mechanism: Agent retrieval, vector search, and observability workloads could lift cloud consumption and retention.
companies.agenticRead: Elastic disclosed agentic Kubernetes investigations and MCP-based observability skills, alongside growth in cloud and contracted revenue metrics.
companies.counterpoint: Agentic product releases are not an agent-specific revenue disclosure; net expansion was approximately 111% and must be followed over time.

companies.mechanism: More autonomous software can create more logs, traces, and AI-observability demand.
companies.agenticRead: The company released autonomous SRE and cloud-SRE agent capabilities while reporting sharply higher logs consumption, a potentially relevant observability-consumption signal.
companies.counterpoint: Logs and ARR growth are not proof of agent-led demand; the fiscal-year reported ARR guide incorporates FX headwinds and is lower in reported growth terms than the quarter's ARR growth.

companies.mechanism: AI gateway, MCP gateway, and application-delivery controls may become a necessary part of enterprise agent infrastructure.
companies.agenticRead: F5 subsequently integrated its AI Gateway with an MCP Gateway for agent-to-tool governance; this establishes product relevance, not monetization or adoption evidence.
companies.counterpoint: AI Gateway and MCP Gateway revenue, attach rates, and customer usage are not separately reported, so the capture link remains unproven.

companies.mechanism: Enterprise AI data transfer and policy enforcement could expand the security control plane around agent deployment.
Agents communicating with customers or counterparties could compound paid messaging and engagement events.
Machine and AI traffic reaching origin infrastructure may create incremental edge and delivery consumption.
Delegated authority and machine identities could create a new identity-management layer for agents.
